cohort: 242 parturient patients admitted to the Department of Gynaecology at Doctors Hospital and Medical Centre, Lahore, Pakistan, who underwent parturition, excluding those presenting for emergency or elective caesarean sections, or with bleeding diathesis/coagulation disorders.
finding: The labour epidural rate was 50.82%, with a minor complication rate of 14.6% (most commonly hypotension, shivering, dural tap, blood tap, and post-dural puncture headache) and no major complications observed.
